SEED-MATCHED BRK PROOFS (new technique): run scalar-lo, scalar-hi, brk and a repeat of scalar-lo back-to-back inside one second; the repeat colliding byte-identically proves the shared seed, and the brk differing from both endpoints is then valid. octvary 0.1->2 and cyclelen -c 4->100 both proven capable this way; -s refuses brk.
octvary 0 ACCEPTED despite quoted floor 0.000002 (near-passthrough 1.9977). cyclelen 2-32767 verbatim (1 and 1.5 refused), default 64.
ct2 refused 'Cycle too large for buffer at 1.486077'; stereo refused -> mono.

cyclecnt brk 2->30 differs from both endpoints; -s refuses brk and DROPS material (0.5011->0.4439 = -100cyc/4 at 440 Hz).
ct2 refused; stereo refused verbatim; deterministic.

Deterministic; stereo refused. Submodes 2 (omit above) and 3 (band, freq1 freq2) share the engine - execute().
